newsitem.title: UK: Labour risks 1.5 mln jobless rise - UK's Lang.
newsitem.headline: Labour risks 1.5 mln jobless rise - UK's Lang.

text.p: The opposition Labour Party's plans to adopt continental European-style business regulation risks putting 1.5 million people out of work, Trade and Industry Secretary Ian Lang said on Wednesday.
He said this would be the increase in British joblessness if Britain had the same percentage rate of unemployment as major continental countries such as Germany, Italy, France and Spain.
"British enterprise has created on average over 100 jobs every working hour since 1992," Lang told a news conference at Conservative Party headquarters in London.

"We have a flexible and deregulated Labour market which is delivering jobs and bringing prosperity to more and more people. Yet Labour would put all this at risk as a result of (party leader) Tony Blair's desire never to be isolated in Europe."
Lang was speaking soon after the release of British unemployment figures showing a much larger than expected fall of 67,800 in January. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7767
